title: Serum 2 Control Surface — Complete Qualification Audit

DISCOVERED.definition: Parameter exists in VST3, identified in family discovery phase

ROUTE_RESOLVED.definition: host_param route proven via representative testing; set/readback successful

CONTROLLABLE.definition: Parameter successfully set and read back with meaningful value change

GENERATION_VERIFIED.definition: Mutation correctly persisted in VST3 state across set/readback cycle

RESTORATION_VERIFIED.definition: Parameter successfully restored to baseline after mutation

BEHAVIOR_OBSERVED.definition: Audio effect of parameter mutation measured
BEHAVIOR_OBSERVED.reason: Out of scope for qualification harness; requires render + measurement

CAUSAL_VERIFIED.reason: Set/readback proves route, not causality; BEHAVIOR_OBSERVED required for causal gate

P1_PRODUCTION_READY.reason: No behavioral measurement; no production evidence

P3_HYPOTHESIS.reason: Route proven; threshold for P3 not required

UNKNOWN.reason: Meaningful parameter identified but route not yet proven; low priority

NOT_SUPPORTED.reason: Correctly filtered as non-synthesis/MIDI/unknown; not synthesis controls

architectural_findings.ableton_mcp_serum_surface: NOT_EXPOSED (Ableton MCP limitation: only 1 parameter exposed)
architectural_findings.serum_vst3_control_surface: AVAILABLE_VIA_DAWDREAMER (proven with real VST3 representative testing)
architectural_findings.mutation_route: host_param via DawDreamer VST3 plugin processor

proven_representatives.INTEGER: B Octave (set baseline→0, readback 0, restore successful)
proven_representatives.SCALAR: B Level (set baseline→0.75, readback 0.75, restore successful)
